name: The Cascades parking area at Cascade Creek bridge, Highway 140
basis: Mountain Project Cascade Area Getting There: 'Park at the parking area at Cascade Bridge. Approaches are obvious.' Brief lot is named The Cascades Parking, at the Cascade Creek bridge, ~0.3 km from the area coordinate.

name: Highway 140 pullout on the river side below Cookie Cliff
basis: Mountain Project Cookie Area Getting There: 'Park in a pullout on the river side of the road, about 1/2 mile down the canyon from the Cascade Creek bridge.' Cascade Creek bridge is at the Cascades lot (37.7239,-119.7122); this unnamed pullout is ~0.79 km (0.49 mi) down-canyon of it and ~0.2 km from the Cookie area coordinate. Chosen by distance along the road; river-side not confirmable from the brief.

name: Bridalveil Fall parking lot on Wawona Road
basis: Mountain Project Leaning Tower Area Getting There: 'Start at the Bridalveil Fall pullout off the southeast side of Wawona Road' (the El Capitan free shuttle stops here in peak season; also says park a couple hundred yards down the road at a pull-out if the lot bars overnight parking). Brief lot (access yes, no fee) sits at the Bridalveil Fall trailhead (37.7167,-119.6509), ~0.5 km from the area coordinate; matched by position.

name: Four Mile Trail parking lot on Southside Drive
basis: Mountain Project Sentinel Rock Getting There: 'Sentinel Rock is found on the south side of the Valley, across from Yosemite Falls. You can park for the Four-Mile Trail to approach.' Brief lot is named Four Mile Trail Parking Lot, ~0.9 km from the area coordinate.
